description: This file is a script for detecting changed paths in a Git repository, classifying their scope for CI/CD workflows, and outputting relevant details. It contains regex patterns for identifying relevant files, functions to analyze change scope, and logic to trigger based on command-line args. It appears intended for automation within a development pipeline to decide what jobs to run based on changed files.

methods.name: detectChangedScope
methods.description: Analyzes an array of changed paths to determine what parts of the project have been affected and what CI jobs should run based on regex pattern tests.

methods.name: listChangedPaths
methods.description: Uses 'git diff --name-only' to list paths changed between two commits or references.

methods.name: writeGitHubOutput
methods.description: Appends CI scope flags to the specified GitHub output file, for use in workflows.

methods.name: isDirectRun
methods.description: Determines if the script is executed directly based on process arguments.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command line arguments for base and head git references.
